title: Treesa-Gayatri Secure Historic World Championships Bronze
indian_angle: The Indian women's doubles pair secured a historic bronze medal at the BWF World Championships, marking a significant milestone for Indian badminton.
summary: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand earned a bronze medal at the BWF World Championships, ending a 15-year drought for Indian women's doubles and highlighting India's growing presence on the global stage.

title: Gopichand Lays Out India's Asian Games Plan After Worlds Bronze
indian_angle: National coach Pullela Gopichand outlines the strategic preparations for the upcoming Asian Games, building on the recent World Championships success.
summary: Following Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand's bronze at the World Championships, chief national coach Pullela Gopichand detailed India's focused training approach for the Asian Games, emphasizing a step-by-step development plan.

title: India Open Super 750 Tournament to Move to Guwahati in 2028
indian_angle: The prestigious India Open Super 750 tournament will shift its venue to Guwahati starting in 2028, bringing a major international badminton event to a new Indian city.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced that the India Open Super 750 tournament will be hosted in Guwahati starting in 2028, indicating a decentralization of major badminton events within the country.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Held in Guwahati for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: A national coaching camp for India's U17 and U15 junior teams was conducted in Guwahati, preparing young talent for the upcoming Badminton Asia Junior Championships.
summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati hosted a crucial coaching camp for the Indian U17 and U15 junior badminton teams, focusing on preparation for the 2026 Badminton Asia Junior Championships.

title: Regulations Released for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has published the regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, detailing the rules for this significant domestic event.
summary: New regulations have been issued by the BAI for the 2026 Inter State Team Championships, providing essential guidelines for participating teams and officials in the national competition.
